name: Dark Forest Stories: Dora The Explorer
source:
In the heart of the Dark forest lives insidious, but very charming evil. And it likes to tell true stories about fairy characters. This story is about Dora the Explorer and her new adventure. Can she help her friends and satisfy them?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thedarkforest/]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
黑暗森林的中心生活着阴险但又非常迷人的邪恶势力。它喜欢讲述有关童话人物的真实故事。这个故事讲述的是探险家朵拉和她的新冒险。她能帮助她的朋友并让他们满意吗？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/thedarkforest/]Patreon[/url]]
